invariants.rationale: The method returns either a new array or the argument array, both of which are non-null at the return point.
The method allocates a new array of "size" if the incoming array is null or too small, and only returns the input array if it has sufficient length.

invariants.expression: array == null || array.length < size ? result != array : result == array
invariants.rationale: If the input array is null or too small, a new array is returned; otherwise, the input array itself is returned.
Whether a new or existing array is returned, it is guaranteed to have length at least 'size'.
Combines non-nullness and size guarantees for the returned array.
